evidence.quote: Union Minister is Arrested and Detained for 30 Consecutive Days for an Offence
Automatic Cessation: If No Advice is provided, Minister automatically ceases to hold office on
Jammu & Kashmir Ministers (J\&K Reorganisation Act, 2019): Applies Same Provisions to Chief Minister
Reappointment: Minister can be Reappointed after release from Custody.
State Ministers & Chief Ministers (Article 164): Similar Provisions apply to Chief Ministers
State Ministers & Chief Ministers (Article 164): Similar Provisions apply to Chief Ministers & State Ministers (Removal Authority: Governor).
Removal by President: The President must remove Minister on advice of Prime Minister.
Delhi Ministers (Article 239AA): Applies Same Rule to Chief Minister and Ministers of Delhi (Removal Authority: Lieutenant Governor).

passage_flags.claim: The Bill specifies who holds the removal power in each case, and it also sets out what follows if the authority does not act.
passage_flags.problem: Generalises: the booklet gives the no-advice consequence (automatic cessation on the 31st day) only for Union Ministers, not for every category.
